fields: [pic=4]<size=18>Come one and all! Be the first to start the firefly orgy!</size>
[pic=3]What, you’re telling me you wouldn’t join something like this if you were a firefly?
[pic=1]Hey, you guys looking for a fun time!
[pic=4]Check out this traveling Firefly orgy! Snacks and refreshments included!
[pic=2]<color=#878375><size=10>Rascal, we’ll have to get some snacks!</size>
[pic=4]Heyyy~ <waitfor=0.5>You guys want in on this Firefly Orgy? <waitfor=0.5>Come on, don’t be shy!

Why do I get the feeling
you’ve done this before?
[pic=6]Because I have absolutely done this before.
[pic=8]<size=18>WHOA</size> did you see how hot that firefly was? <waitfor=0.5>Damn. <waitfor=0.5>She <speed=0.1>thicc!
[pic=7]It just occurred to me that I should maybe prep you for meeting with my folks…
[pic=7]Yeah, just that they’re <waitfor=0.5>a bit <waitfor=0.5>unlike the other critters here.
[pic=7]Heh, right. <waitfor=0.5>So for starters, <waitfor=0.5>they don’t really speak our tongue.
[pic=7]And my Mom is <speed=0.1>kinda<speed=1> <waitfor=0.5>the leader. <waitfor=0.5>She’s the Matriarch.
[pic=7]Yeah… <waitfor=0.5>sorta… <waitfor=0.5>Let’s keep searching for now. <waitfor=0.5>I’ll fill ya in as we go.
[pic=4]<size=18>Firefly Orgy! Come join the firefly orgy!</size>
[pic=6]Right this way. Welcome. Yep, come on in. Watch your step.
[pic=1]Alright, looks like we’re done here. Let’s find some more.
Are you gonna tell me more about your folks?
[pic=7]So, I guess <waitfor=0.5>I’m like… <waitfor=0.5>kinda next in line to lead the mice…
[pic=7]Their way of life is heavy on tradition.
[pic=7]And naturally, those traditions come from their really particular beliefs…
[pic=7]Well <waitfor=0.5>it’s regarding the forest here. <waitfor=0.5>They think some crazy big spirit-beast-thing used to live here.

Sacrifices? Sounds a little out of line
with the whole "forest of love" thing?
[pic=3]Right? And I’ve looked up and down this entire place, <waitfor=0.5>many times.
[pic=3]I’ve had long discussions with Augustus about his findings, and none of this adds up.
[pic=5]Yet I bring it up to my mother, and she insists that this is how things were.
[pic=5]So they spend a lot of their time doing rituals to "appease" this spirit.
[pic=5]And it’s like, <waitfor=0.5>every waking moment, some sort of rule, or weird way of going about something.
[pic=7]It’s really out of touch, and I’ve never really agreed with it.
[pic=7]It’s why I’m always hanging with the critters here.
And you don’t really wanna lead that?
[pic=5]So many of their "rules" all the time, and nothing’s come of it.
[pic=7]Like, I’m OK with these mice doing what they want to do, but my Mom’s set on me being the next leader.
[pic=5]And it’s just hard for me to vibe with all of that…
[pic=7]Well, what with all the recent events going on - what if they were actually kinda right about something?
[pic=5]Anyways, let’s get to more hunting. This is bumming me out.
[pic=1]Oh man! This is a huge group!

[pic=4]Hey guys, wanna
turn up the heat
and join this sweet party?
[pic=4]Lots of attractive Lampyridae ready to mingle!
[pic=1]Oh man, this thing is almost full! One more group should do it!

[pic=5]Then we can go see my folks…
yaaaay…
[pic=5]Yeah… <waitfor=0.5>I think a lot of things are just piling up, and my mind likes to fester on stuff…
[pic=3]Like… <waitfor=0.5>Everything that’s been happening lately… <waitfor=0.5>I’m sure it’s just coincidence…
[pic=5]But I already know how my folks are taking it.
[pic=5]It’s gonna be a headache for sure…
[pic=7]Actually, this is probably rude of me bringing you into this. <waitfor=0.5>You don’t have to come if you don’t want to.
[pic=7]You sure? <waitfor=0.5>I feel like you don’t quite know what you’re getting yourself into…
Just sounds like an adventure to me!

Wait, they aren’t gonna
sacrifice *me* or something, right?
[pic=1]Haha, ok enough chat! We need one more group of flies!
[pic=1]Let’s head over to the deep woods, I'm sure we'll find some there.

[pic=4]<size=18>Last call! <waitfor=0.5>Firefly Orgy! <waitfor=0.5>
Get it while it’s hot!</size>
[pic=1]… Ok, that’s the last of them.
[pic=6]Yeah, these lil guys seem pretty bright to me!
Ok great but like… For how long?
Well they are going to finish eventually, right?
[pic=3]Sorta? Like, there’s a ton in here. There’s definitely going to be constant action.
[pic=6]Just however long they want. I poked holes in the lid so they can cum and go as they please. <waitfor=0.5>Pun intended!
[pic=3]… Are you worried we are using them?
I mean, we’re definitely using them.
[pic=4]Haha, yeah but don’t worry! These guys love it. What do you think bugs do when they’re swarming around like that?
[pic=3]Well. <waitfor=0.5>I think I’ve prepared you for my folks…
[pic=6]Oh, you should know, it’s totally possible you might get swept up in some mouse orgy or something…
Oh! You shoulda started with that!
[pic=3]Haha, perhaps. <waitfor=0.5>Really it’s just wishful thinking. <waitfor=0.5>They usually don’t take too kindly to other critters.
[pic=7]I think it’s easy for them to be intimidated since you guys are so much bigger…
[pic=6]But I’ll put in a good word!
[pic=1]Ok, I think we’re ready… but we still need to check up on some of the critters. We should do that first!
[pic=7]Hey uh… <waitfor=0.5>I don’t really know that guy… <waitfor=0.5>but I’ve heard some bad things about him…
[pic=7]We should get out of here for now…
